changelog:
- Added strict route selection: require explicit scope confirmation (cover only, body illustrations only, or full pack) before proceeding.
- Now mandates having the article or outline as input before suggesting illustration themes; avoids inventing illustrations.
- Revised "Plan the visual sequence" to clarify visual system defaults and accent color use.
- Introduced a structured "Golden path": propose the illustration outline first, confirm style, then generate images; prefer business images when available.
- Updated instructions for capability checks: the exact capability for each tool (generate, transform, edit) must be verified before a paid call.
- Removed the "skill-card.md" documentation for simplification.
summary: Create a WeChat Official Account visual pack from a finished article, outline, brand assets, photos, or visual references. Produce a lead cover plus coordinated in-article illustrations with clear section focus and consistent visual direction for WeChat articles, WeChat post images, brand stories, product explainers, event recaps, and knowledge content.
